msg: The colour or position of the gnome does not seem to have an impact on the mushrooms gained. For a certain amount of rounds either the taller gnomes with a pointy hat will give more mushrooms, or the shorter gnomes with a flat hat will. If you choose a taller gnome and it gives you more mushrooms than a shorter one (at least 5 mushrooms) then keep choosing them. Once the number of mushrooms gained drop below 4-5 for a while try picking the other gnome.
